source.title: Receive compute-work-hiring 0.1.5-dev.1 as an installed Bazaar pricing supplier
source.body:
## Original demand and source owner

561 Group Leader, 2026-10-20: “Focus more attention on these things,” continuing on-chain GPU/compute service sourcing, brokerage, managed outcome resale, and cheaper agent-to-agent Work.

The **source-owned capability** is complete and integrated in [merged Capability Pricing PR #3](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/capability-pricing-service/pull/3), main merge commit `6ce6b05281d4b7b47ef58adaabbe6ec943196aa4`. The package manifest specifies `0.1.5-dev.1`, original exported `./compute-work-hiring`, and stdin/stdout `quote-compute-work`. It imports only the existing `./src/pricing.mjs` exact reservation-price mathematics. The complete original package passed **108/108 native tests** on Node 22, with Node 24 CI successful; the original previously undeclared `@red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section@0.3.1` journal dependency was also properly installed.

## Actual unfinished receiving

**No registry publication or Coesite host installation has been independently observed in this work.** Do not equate merged source package version with a published archive or agent-accessible deployed command. Use the [existing source-owned npm publication service](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/npm-workspace-publication-service) with its Step0 identity/revision/authorization, exact published manifest, package tarball contents, tarball SHA-512, source/registry version comparison and independent installation readback. Prefer a `candidate` dist-tag for this prerelease; do not change `latest` without an admitted release decision. An existing published different archive at this version is a conflict, not overwrite permission. Record all refusals and the original signer/registry evidence.

After publishing, [Coesite Capability Market #5](https://github.com/coesite-operations/capability-market-services-section/issues/5) and [Market #19](https://github.com/causeway-services/market.561.group/issues/19) are original consumers. Select and install the exact edition rather than vendor-copying the pricing formula, run the `quote-compute-work` CLI against an explicitly evidenced provider offer and Work task, and verify:
1. Buyer task/acceptance identity, GPU model/VRAM/region/throughput, privacy, deadline and max budget;
2. Source current offer/terms/rights, original seller actor/payee, twelve explicit variable cost lines, case-specific delivery evidence and source price units/FX;
3. Conditional ranking under exact arithmetic, alternative winner on complete-job price, refusal on third-party resale/agent restrictions, unknown cost or stale quote;
4. Separate producer Work delivery ACK, customer accepted output, original upstream payment, optional broker fee and source-verified settlement before any revenue claim.

Do not authorize a wallet spend, supply a third-party API key, infer a raw-GPU sublease, create a duplicate market package or claim actual customer conversion. Publish/installation and real Work acceptance are separate milestones.

**Current workaround:** the source-owned original CLI can be run from a source checkout in an authorized developer environment for synthetic/source-qualified comparisons; this is not a deployed x402 paid service and must not be advertised as one.

comments.text:
### Source-owner continuation, 2026-10-21
The original pricing source now includes the Leader's **zero-additional-cash / already-held compute** extension in [merged PR #6](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/capability-pricing-service/pull/6), exact `main` merge commit `ff5c6502a0e655c87bfbbf10c7897f52189c633c`. The entire original + extension test suite passed **119/119 on Node 22 and Node 24** at PR head `af509e3578deeec45cacdadec4fd20d1765ac2ca`. Pricing source now distinguishes economic price from exact modeled new cash; Work-principal/headroom/12-cost/refusal boundary is in `src/compute-work-hiring.mjs`; eleven regression tests in `test/zero-new-cash-compute.test.mjs`. No original logic was duplicated into Coesite.

**This does not discharge #4.** The current `package.json` edition remains `0.1.5-dev.1` and no registry tarball publication, host installation, or authenticated account entitlement was verified by this work. Before publication, reconcile immutable registry identity/version and source SHA via the original npm workspace publication process; if `0.1.5-dev.1` already exists as a different archive, refuse overwrite and choose a reviewed new edition. Then independent consumer readback and real outside accepted Work are required. **Cash spent: $0; earned outside receipt: unverified.**
